entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. The pulse monitoring is completely off.
I can certainly look into that for you. Just to be sure I'm understanding correctly, is it a technical fault you're seeing with the pulse readings, or is it more of a preference?
It's a definite fault. The readings are basically garbage. It will say my heart rate is 150 when I'm just sitting on the couch. It's not a reliable device.

I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing that. That's definitely not the quality we aim for. I have a few troubleshooting steps that can often resolve sensor inaccuracies. Would you be willing to try one or two things with me?
No, thank you. I really don't have time for all that. I've already tried turning it off and on again. At this point, I just want my money back so I can get something that works.
I understand your position. Our usual process for a reported defect is to verify the issue with our technical support team before we can authorize a return.
Look, I'm not interested in a long technical call. The product doesn't work as advertised. Can we just start the refund process? Is there a partial credit or something we can do to avoid the hassle?
I hear you. Let me just pull up your account and review our return policy for your order. One moment please.
Okay, I have your order details here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered to you 34 days ago.

Alright. Well, according to the policy information I have here, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 34, you're well within that window. We can definitely process a full refund for you.
Oh, perfect. See? That was much easier. I appreciate you taking care of that.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Excellent. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's all. Have a good day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
